Strict monotonicity of logistic plus connectedness means every conditional imitation probability equals iff all Delta_i constant. Regularity implies BB^T1=gr1, so for v=lambda-mean(lambda)1 we have BB^Tv=0 iff ||B^Tv||²=0, yielding incidence-kernel classification and rank criterion. For graph incidence B^Tv edge values v_i+v_j, thus nonzero iff connected bipartite; complete equal-part g-partite uniform hypergraphs have kernel dimension g-1. Spectral lower bound uses L and signless Q on mean-zero vectors and positivity of Q in nonbipartite connected case; logistic derivative bounded omega/4 yields edgewise Lipschitz and synchronous T-step coupling TV<=min(1,T epsilon). Independently checked all profiles on C4, triangle and 6-vertex tripartite with exact rational offsets (-1 all), (-17/20,-1,-23/20), (-2 all); unbounded-size theorem follows from linear algebra.
